title: Replacement Frequency Table for PAP Supply Items
content:
Under the PAP Supply Replenishment Program every supply item has its own replacement limit on each resupply schedule, stated as a number of units allowed per period of months. On the five coverage schedules the period of an item is measured on a rolling basis from the item's last service date; the Self-Pay Supply Subscription measures no period.

## Units allowed per period

| Item (HCPCS) | Medicare Part B | Medicare Advantage | Medicaid | Commercial HMO | Commercial PPO | Self-Pay Supply Subscription |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Full face mask (A7030) | 1 per 3 months | 1 per 3 months | 1 per 6 months | 1 per 3 months | 1 per 3 months | no limit |
| Full face mask cushion (A7031) | 1 per 1 month | 1 per 1 month | 1 per 1 month | 1 per 1 month | 2 per 1 month | no limit |
| Nasal mask or pillows interface (A7034) | 1 per 3 months | 1 per 3 months | 1 per 6 months | 1 per 3 months | 1 per 3 months | no limit |
| Nasal mask cushion (A7032) | 2 per 1 month | 2 per 1 month | 1 per 1 month | 2 per 1 month | 2 per 1 month | no limit |
| Nasal pillows pair (A7033) | 2 per 1 month | 2 per 1 month | 1 per 1 month | 2 per 1 month | 2 per 1 month | no limit |
| Headgear (A7035) | 1 per 6 months | 1 per 6 months | 1 per 6 months | 1 per 6 months | 1 per 6 months | no limit |
| Chinstrap (A7036) | 1 per 6 months | 1 per 6 months | 1 per 6 months | 1 per 6 months | 1 per 6 months | no limit |
| Standard tubing (A7037) | 1 per 3 months | 1 per 3 months | 1 per 6 months | 1 per 3 months | 1 per 3 months | no limit |
| Heated tubing (A4604) | 1 per 3 months | 1 per 3 months | 1 per 6 months | 1 per 3 months | 1 per 3 months | no limit |
| Disposable filter (A7038) | 2 per 1 month | 2 per 1 month | 2 per 1 month | 2 per 1 month | 4 per 1 month | no limit |
| Non-disposable filter (A7039) | 1 per 6 months | 1 per 6 months | 1 per 6 months | 1 per 6 months | 1 per 6 months | no limit |
| Humidifier water chamber (A7046) | 1 per 6 months | 1 per 6 months | 1 per 12 months | 1 per 6 months | 1 per 6 months | no limit |

On the Self-Pay Supply Subscription every item is recorded with a quantity of 0 over 0 months, and a quantity of 0 means no limit.

## How the period is measured

| Schedule | Period basis |
|---|---|
| Medicare Part B, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Commercial HMO, Commercial PPO | rolling from the item's last service date |
| Self-Pay Supply Subscription | none |

## Points of comparison

- The Medicaid Resupply Schedule is the narrowest coverage schedule: masks, interfaces and both kinds of tubing come once every 6 months, nasal cushions and pillow pairs one a month, and the water chamber once every 12 months.
- The Commercial PPO Resupply Schedule is the widest for consumables: 2 full face mask cushions a month and 4 disposable filters a month.
- Headgear, chinstraps and non-disposable filters carry the same limit, 1 per 6 months, on every coverage schedule.
